name: EGFR total protein Western blot
description: Starve cells 16 h, stimulate with 10-100 ng/mL EGF for 0-60 min, lyse in RIPA with phosphatase inhibitors, SDS-PAGE 8%, transfer to PVDF, probe with anti-EGFR antibody.

name: EGFR phosphorylation Western blot
description: Starve cells 16 h, stimulate with EGF, immunoprecipitate EGFR or use phospho-EGFR (Tyr1173) antibody for direct Western blot. Quantify band intensity.

name: EGFR activation ELISA
description: Capture EGFR with coated antibody, detect phospho-EGFR with HRP-conjugated phosphotyrosine antibody. Suitable for kinetic dose-response.

name: MAPK/ERK phosphorylation Western blot
description: Starve and stimulate with EGF, run SDS-PAGE 10%, probe with anti-phospho-p44/42 MAPK (Erk1/2) (Thr202/Tyr204) antibody.

name: ERK kinase activity assay
description: Immunoprecipitate ERK2, incubate with recombinant MEK1 and Elk-1 substrate, measure phosphate incorporation.

name: MEK phosphorylation Western blot
description: Detect phospho-MEK1/2 (Ser217/221) after EGF stimulation. Use total MEK as loading control.

name: RAF activation assay
description: Pull down active RAF with GST-RBD beads, probe with anti-RAF antibody. Measure GTP-bound RAF.

name: RAS-GTP pull-down assay
description: Use GST-Raf1-RBD beads to capture active GTP-bound RAS, detect by Western blot with anti-pan-RAS antibody.

name: SHC phosphorylation Western blot
description: Detect phospho-SHC after EGF stimulation using phosphotyrosine antibody following SHC immunoprecipitation.

name: GRB2 recruitment co-IP
description: Immunoprecipitate EGFR after EGF stimulation, probe for associated GRB2 by Western blot.

name: SOS recruitment assay
description: Pull down GRB2-SOS complex after EGF stimulation, detect SOS1 by Western blot.

name: AKT phosphorylation Western blot
description: Detect phospho-AKT (Ser473) after growth factor stimulation. Use total AKT as loading control.

name: PI3K lipid kinase assay
description: Immunoprecipitate p85/p110 PI3K, assay conversion of PI(4,5)P2 to PI(3,4,5)P3 using radioactive ATP.

name: mTOR phosphorylation Western blot
description: Detect phospho-mTOR (Ser2448) after growth factor stimulation.

name: TGF-beta receptor phosphorylation Western blot
description: Starve cells, stimulate with 5 ng/mL TGF-beta, detect phospho-TGFBR by immunoprecipitation and Western blot.

name: SMAD2/3 phosphorylation Western blot
description: Detect phospho-SMAD2 (Ser465/467) after TGF-beta stimulation. Use total SMAD2/3 as loading control.

name: EGFR qPCR
description: Extract RNA after EGF stimulation, reverse transcribe, quantify EGFR mRNA by SYBR Green qPCR with GAPDH normalization.

name: MAPK pathway phospho-flow cytometry
description: Fix and permeabilize cells after stimulation, stain with anti-phospho-ERK antibody, analyze by flow cytometry for single-cell kinetics.

name: EGF ligand quantification ELISA
description: Measure extracellular EGF concentration by sandwich ELISA. Useful for ligand depletion experiments.

name: Receptor internalization flow cytometry
description: Stain surface EGFR with non-permeabilizing antibody before and after EGF stimulation to quantify receptor internalization.
